name: Banh khao
summary: Bánh khảo is a soft, sweet, fragrant cake of fine glutinous flour and honey, made in the same family as bánh pẻng phạ.
origin: The eastern road, and a gift from town.
howToEat: Buy it in the eastern-road villages or at the gift stalls in town to carry home.
where: Eastern-road villages, and gift stalls in Cao Bang city.
seoTitle: Banh khao in Cao Bang — glutinous cake
seoDescription: Bánh khảo is a soft, sweet, fragrant cake of fine glutinous flour and honey, made in the same family as bánh pẻng phạ.
